item.title: 2015 Porsche Cayenne Turbo at No Reserve
item.description: This 2015 Porsche Cayenne Turbo is finished in Moonlight Blue Metallic over Cognac and Espresso Natural leather and has 48k miles following registration history in California since new. item.title: 2025 Porsche 911 GT3 RS Weissach
item.description: This 2025 Porsche 911 GT3 RS has 19 miles and was optioned from the factory with the Weissach Package, which reduced weight by utilizing a carbon-composite roof panel, front lid, anti-roll bars, and interior trim. Its body is finished in Arctic Gray with red graphics, and power is provided by a 4.0-liter flat-six that drives the rear wheels through a seven-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transaxle and an electronically locking differential. item.title: RS-Style 1971 Porsche 911T Coupe 3.2L 5-Speed
item.description: This 1971 Porsche 911T coupe was modified in RS-style over the course of three years by RS Werks of Newark, Delaware, including the installation of steel fender flares, fiberglass bumpers, and a 3.2L flat-six. The build was completed in 2018 and also involved repainting the car in Albert Blue as well as installing RSR-style 15" Fuchs alloy wheels, Bilstein shocks, Turbo tie rods, Weltmeister adjustable spring plates and sway bars, and Turbo torsion bars. item.title: 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle Malibu Convertible SS 454 4-Speed
item.description: This 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle Malibu SS convertible is powered by a 454ci V8 linked with a Muncie four-speed manual transmission and a PosiTraction differential, and it was refurbished before the current owner's acquisition in 2017. It is finished in red with white stripes and a white convertible top, and the cabin is outfitted with front bucket seats, a center console, a Muncie shifter, and Ivory vinyl upholstery. item.title: 1955 Austin-Healey 100 BN1 Roadster at No Reserve
item.description: This 1955 Austin-Healey 100 BN1 roadster is powered by a 2.7-liter inline-four equipped with dual SU carburetors that is backed by a retrofitted four-speed manual transmission with overdrive. Finished in white with a removable white soft top and tonneau cover over black vinyl upholstery, the car rides on 15" knock-off wire wheels and is fitted with Dunlop front disc brakes. item.title: 42k-Mile 1999 Mitsubishi Eclipse Coupe GSX 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1999 Mitsubishi Eclipse GSX coupe has 42k miles and is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-four that drives all four wheels through a five-speed manual transaxle. The car is equipped with Tokico suspension, an aftermarket exhaust system, and a GReddy-branded blow-off valve and intercooler piping. item.title: 15k-Mile 1995 Ferrari F355 Spider 6-Speed
item.description: This 1995 Ferrari F355 Spider is finished in Azzurro Hyperion Metallic over blue Connolly leather and powered by a 3.5-liter DOHC V8 linked with a gated six-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential. It also has a black soft top, a vented engine cover, an integrated rear spoiler, pop-up headlights, side air intakes, 18″ five-spoke magnesium wheels, a gated shifter, automatic climate control, and a Sony stereo. item.title: 57k-Kilometer RoW 1997 Porsche 911 Carrera 4S 6-Speed
item.description: This 1997 Porsche 911 Carrera 4S is a German-market example that is finished in Viola Metallic over Classic Gray leather and now has 57k kilometers (~35k miles). The car is powered by a 3.6-liter flat-six that drives all four wheels through a six-speed manual transaxle with a limited-slip differential. item.title: 1995 Acura NSX-T 5-Speed
item.description: This 1995 Acura NSX-T shows 61k miles following registration history in Arizona and California, and it is powered by a 3.0-liter VTEC V6 paired with a five-speed manual transaxle.
